The '''Executive Cruiser''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
